lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced vertical columns of ovoid, high-luminance spots arranged in a grid-like configuration along the lateral midline posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical linear bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a defined coordinate matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally across the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, circular, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the leading edge and central surface of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An elongated, high-luminance biological attachment (remora) is visible on the lower-mid lateral flank; no permanent dermis scarring is identifiable.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin in the lower right quadrant exhibits a high-density clustering of small, irregular high-luminance spots.
